column1: # docs/risk.tsv (D88): what a change under each path puts at risk, for
# `vx test --changed`. The longest path matching a file wins; a file with
# no row risks everything. Columns: a path (a directory ends in /); the
# arches to build (all: amd64's and arm64's; another arch named is built,
# not tested); the SwiftPM test targets; the ctest names; vx's checks
# (man, loc, hardware, rc-oracle, risk). - is none, all is everything. Every
# test target and ctest name is named by some row (vx ci checks), so a new
# test gets a place here. The full suite, `vx ci`, closes a milestone.
